coach.note: The Star (17 January 2025) says she has no personal coach and trains herself on a programme from her management, Ikaika Sports. The earlier entry named Julien Di Maria from a Nation article that could not be opened (HTTP 403), so it is not confirmed.

shoe.note: Article of 7 November 2024 says she won New York in the adidas Adizero Adios Pro 4; it does not call adidas her sponsor.
